findings.affected_principal: Any browser user who can craft URLs (no frontend auth gate).
findings.affected_resource_data_state: Manager/lender/risk/disbursement UI exposure; client-side step-order integrity.
findings.demonstrated_security_relevant_outcome: Demonstrated: privileged steps render without frontend state/actor check. Not demonstrated: backend authorization bypass.
findings.source_to_sink_data_flow: Direct /loan-flow/<step> URL with query IDs or missing IDs -> loader returns null or workflowData -> layout plus child renders -> workflowMetadata from query/defaults -> event POST enabled.
findings.title: Unguarded loan-flow rendering with missing or foreign workflow IDs
unresolved_backend_deployment_assumption: Backend state-machine and WORKFLOW_ID/WORKFLOW_ACTOR binding per eventType require backend spec/fixture.
findings.validation_notes: Frontend route-rendering weakness only; backend bypass not claimed.
findings.smallest_source_remediation: Add loader guard on /loan-flow and children: deny to / or not-your-turn when IDs absent or backend state does not authorize path; never return null into privileged step.

findings.affected_principal: Any holder or crafter of WORKFLOW_ID / WORKFLOW_ACTOR values.
findings.affected_resource_data_state: Borrower/co-borrower PII in transit; workflow write integrity.
findings.demonstrated_security_relevant_outcome: Demonstrated: PII requests carry no auth material from GOPRO and default to cleartext http. Not demonstrated: backend accepts them unauthenticated.
findings.source_to_sink_data_flow: formData plus query-derived workflowMetadata -> JSON.stringify event -> fetch http://localhost:3000 POST with Content-Type only.
findings.title: PII event POSTs with no frontend auth material and hardcoded cleartext endpoint
unresolved_backend_deployment_assumption: Backend authN/Z, WORKFLOW_ID entropy, production host/scheme.
findings.smallest_source_remediation: Centralize one API client with https-only except loopback dev, env base URL, session auth; remove per-page URL literals.

findings.affected_principal: Local observers, history readers, console/log access holders.
findings.demonstrated_security_relevant_outcome: Demonstrated: console, DOM, URL/history exposure. Not demonstrated: remote log aggregation.
findings.source_to_sink_data_flow: Full payload and viewResult -> console plus IDs -> JSX text and URL.searchParams -> location/history.
findings.title: PII and workflow IDs in console, DOM, and URL
unresolved_backend_deployment_assumption: Whether production aggregates console output; page caching.
findings.smallest_source_remediation: Remove PII/response console calls or gate behind DEV; stop rendering IDs; minimize URL-carried IDs.

findings.affected_resource_data_state: Step-label trust; backend state attribution if consumed.
findings.demonstrated_security_relevant_outcome: Demonstrated: semantic spoofing and binding confusion. Not demonstrated: XSS or script execution.
findings.source_to_sink_data_flow: Query STATE/COMPONENT_KEY -> workflowMetadata -> JSX text and POST JSON.
findings.title: Query-controlled state keys rendered and re-POSTed
unresolved_backend_deployment_assumption: Whether backend uses client-sent state keys for transitions.
findings.smallest_source_remediation: Treat query keys as hints; allowlist states; derive binding from bootstrap response.

findings.demonstrated_security_relevant_outcome: Demonstrated: missing client checks and filename-only advancement; File bytes never sent. Not demonstrated: unsafe server file handling.
findings.source_to_sink_data_flow: e.target.files -> presence check -> names/counts/booleans -> JSON.stringify POST; bytes never in body.
findings.title: Document steps advance on filenames or booleans without validation or binary upload
unresolved_backend_deployment_assumption: Backend document intake design and server MIME/size/AV policy.
findings.smallest_source_remediation: Enforce type/size/count pre-submit; require multipart upload with server checks; never advance on names alone.

findings.affected_principal: ID enumerator or network observer (backend conditional).
findings.demonstrated_security_relevant_outcome: Demonstrated: trust-driven auto-navigation without allowlist. Not demonstrated: backend auth failure.
findings.source_to_sink_data_flow: Query IDs -> POST workflow-navigator every 3s -> componentKey change -> resolveWorkflowRoute -> navigate.
findings.title: Polling auto-navigation on unallowlisted componentKey
unresolved_backend_deployment_assumption: Backend auth/rate-limit, ID entropy, poll response schema.
findings.smallest_source_remediation: Authenticate poll, add backoff and attempt cap, allowlist forward transitions, use https.

findings.affected_principal: Deployer or operator; network observer if default promoted.
findings.affected_resource_data_state: Applicant PII in transit; deployment correctness.
findings.demonstrated_security_relevant_outcome: Demonstrated: unsafe default plus env/doc drift. Not demonstrated: production cleartext deployment.
findings.source_to_sink_data_flow: Absent env -> hardcoded http://localhost:3000 -> fetch; documented port 3001 unused.
findings.title: Hardcoded cleartext localhost default with conflicting documented env and port
unresolved_backend_deployment_assumption: Production env values and dist bundle contents.
findings.smallest_source_remediation: Single VITE_WORKFLOW_API_BASE_URL https-only except loopback, fail closed, replace literals, align docs.

findings.affected_resource_data_state: Component API exposure; insecure defaults hygiene.
findings.demonstrated_security_relevant_outcome: Demonstrated: source exposure with demo identities and no env guard. Not demonstrated: public production exposure.
findings.source_to_sink_data_flow: Route / -> playground tree with demo identities and snippets.
findings.title: Root route exposes playground with demo identities
unresolved_backend_deployment_assumption: Deployment routing and whether playground ships to prod.
findings.smallest_source_remediation: Gate demo routes behind DEV; replace demo values with synthetic placeholders.

findings.established_from_gopro: Frontend sends client verdicts and demo values as formData in event POST bodies.
missing_backend_evidence_required: Whether verdict fields are authoritative or ignored; signed proof requirement; per-event contract.
findings.smallest_appropriate_remediation: Send raw evidence references only; remove hardcoded PII and simulation.
findings.title: Client-asserted verification outcomes; backend trust unresolved

findings.established_from_gopro: VITE_APP_THEME flows unsanitized into path.resolve for @theme alias.
missing_backend_evidence_required: Build-env ownership, allowed theme set, fail-closed behavior.
findings.smallest_appropriate_remediation: Allowlist theme names; reject separators and parent sequences; fail closed.
findings.title: Theme env into path.resolve without allowlist; control unresolved

findings.reason_rejected: External open redirect disproved because appendWorkflowParamsToRedirect returns only pathname plus search before redirect.
findings.residual_observation_not_a_finding: Same-origin forced navigation remains observable but is not an external open redirect.
findings.title: Rejected external open redirect
